1:1: “Yahweh” is God’s proper Name, sometimes rendered “LORD” (all caps) in other translations.
2:2: “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:4: A cubit is the length from the tip of the middle finger to the elbow on a man’s arm, or about 18 inches or 46 centimeters, so 2,000 cubits is about 920 meters.
7:21: A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces.
24:32: Hebrew: kesitahs. A kesitah was a kind of silver coin.
